title: Seaside Thyme
meta_description: Discover the ideal 30A, FL vacation home at “Seaside Thyme”, a luxury seven-bedroom, seven full and one half-bath vacation rental. Perfect for 24 guests, this property features a private pool, Gulf views, elevator and golf cart. Reserve your unforgettable
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Construction - Private Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Multiple Gulf-View Balconies - Easy Beach Access - Elevator - Outdoor Dining, Gas Grill & Lounge Area - Ping Pong Table for Family Fun - 6-Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bikes Included Welcome to Seaside Thyme, a newly built luxury beach retreat perfectly positioned in the heart of Seagrove Beach, just steps from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and a short walk to the charm, dining, and boutiques of Seaside. Designed for elevated coastal living, this stunning home blends refined finishes with thoughtful amenities to create an effortless and memorable beach experience. The interior showcases expansive open-concept living spaces filled with natural light, high ceilings, and sophisticated coastal design. The gourmet chef’s kitchen is both beautiful and functional, featuring a gas range, premium appliances, and a butler’s pantry — ideal for hosting, entertaining, or accommodating private chef experiences. Seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living areas makes gathering easy and elegant. Step outside to your private outdoor oasis, where a heated pool, covered lounge areas, and refined landscaping invite relaxation from morning to evening. Three expansive balconies with Gulf views provide the perfect setting for sunrise coffee or sunset conversation, while the outdoor gas grill and ping pong table offer casual luxury and entertainment for all ages. Getting around is effortless with a 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, making beach days and trips into Seaside simple and enjoyable. An elevator ensures comfort and convenience throughout every level of the home. With its prime Seagrove Beach location, modern coastal architecture, and resort-style amenities, Seaside Thyme offers a refined yet relaxed setting for an elevated 30A getaway. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor – One Bedroom - King Bedroom with en-suite bathroom, Walk in Shower - Powder Bath Third Floor – Two Bedrooms + Bunk Room - Master King Bedroom with en-suite Bathroom, Large Walk in Shower, separate Tub - Master King Bedroom with en-suite Bathroom, Large Walk in Shower, separate Tub - Bunk Area includes , 8 Twin Bunks w Full Bathroom Shower/Tub Combo Fourth Floor – 4 Bedrooms - 1 Bedroom with a King Bed - 1 Bedroom with a King Bed - 1 Bedroom with a King Bed - 1 Bedroom with 2 Full Beds - Two Full Bathrooms, each with Walk in Showers - One Full Bathroom with a Tub
